newsitem.title: UK: Scots Pride in separate talks to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Scots Pride in separate talks to sell unit.

text.p: Scottish Pride Holdings Plc said on Monday it was in talks to sell its UHT division to another company instead of Scottish Milk Ltd.
The processor and distributor of milk and associated products previously said it was in talks to sell its UHT and cheese divisions to Scottish Milk.
But the company said it believed it could get a better price for its UHT division if that business was sold separately.
"The board will continue to examine all the options regarding the future of its cheese division," the company said in a statement.

Scottish Pride also said it was in talks with Robert Wiseman Dairies Plc about the potential disposal of its fresh milk division. Earlier this month, Britain's Department of Trade and Industry said it would seek undertakings from Wiseman to prevent the deal from operating against the public interest.
